_comment: Copy to desktop.config.json (git-ignored) and fill in absolute paths. Environment variables VIETDOC_PYTHON, VIETDOC_PADDLEX_HOME and VIETDOC_MODEL_ROOT take precedence. modelRoot: <ABSOLUTE PATH TO A VERIFIED COPY OF>\models
